summary: std/archive untar: the holes of an archive's sparse files add at most 1 GiB, past which untar fails with "archive/tar: sparse files expand past 1 GiB"
details: the holes of an archive's sparse files add at most 1 GiB, past which untar fails with "archive/tar: sparse files expand past 1 GiB"; a few KB could declare terabytes, all built in memory. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/archive untar, native backends): the holes of an archive's sparse files add at most 1 GiB, past which untar fails with "archive/tar: sparse files expand past 1 GiB"; a few KB could declare terabytes, all built in memory. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
